visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man sits at a white table in a modern living room, focused on his smartphone. A young girl in a pink shirt enters from the left, grabs his arm, and looks up pleadingly with an expressive facial expression. (2) A teenage girl in a white shirt enters from the right and joins the first girl, placing her hands on the man's shoulders to plead with him. (3) The man looks exasperated, puts his phone down, and gestures for silence with his hands. He stands up and walks away through a doorway into a lit hallway. (4) In the hallway, the man is met by a woman in a white top who embraces him and pleads as well. The man reacts with a comical look of shock and frustration. (5) The man runs back into the living room and jumps onto a grey sofa. The three females immediately surround him, talking simultaneously and tugging at his clothes while he holds his head. (6) The man shouts for them to stop, then the scene cuts to a brightly lit product shot where he holds three colorful cups of Baby Shark Tteokbokki in front of the camera. (7) Close-up shots show the man's hands opening a cup, adding seasoning and water, then placing it in a microwave. (8) A spoon lifts several small white tteokbokki pieces shaped like sea creatures (sharks, whales) from the cup to show their detail. (9) Individual members of the family are shown tasting different flavors of the tteokbokki in close-ups, smiling, giving thumbs-up gestures, and eating with spoons. (10) The man introduces a new packaged product, Songsong Tteokbokki, and eats it with chopsticks, showing the unique hollow center of the rice cake. (11) The two daughters appear on screen together with digital question marks above them, looking puzzled by the man's description. (12) Finally, the man and woman act affectionately on the sofa while eating, while the daughters watch from the foreground with expressions of boredom and mild disgust.
